Four cultures and plenty of life The Mosque–Cathedral , the Alcázar fortress of the Christian Monarchs , the Synagogue and the Roman bridge are fine examples of Córdoba’s historic quarter. A city that reflects its Roman past and the coexistence of Christian, Islamic and Jewish cultures throughout its history.
